set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

encapsulation [parameter3].explanation: Configure the envelope type of the interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

ppp-options chap hostname [parameter3].explanation: The command sets the CHAP hostname for PPP authentication, where `[parameter3]` specifies the hostname to be used during CHAP negotiation.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The hostname for PPP CHAP authentication.

ppp-options chap password [parameter3].explanation: The command sets the CHAP (Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol) password for PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) authentication, where `[parameter3]` specifies the password value.

parameters.name: password
parameters.explanation: The password for PPP CHAP authentication.

set access ppp profile [parameter1].explanation: The command sets a PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) profile named `[parameter1]` in the access configuration, defining authentication and connection parameters for PPP sessions.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.explanation: The name of the PPP configuration profile, for example, default.

authentication [parameter2].explanation: The command `authentication [parameter2]` in Junos configures the authentication method or key for a protocol or interface, where `[parameter2]` specifies the authentication type or key.

parameters.name: authentication
parameters.explanation: The authentication method, for example, CHAP.

local username [parameter2].explanation: The command `local username [parameter2]` creates a local user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter2]` specifies the username for authentication purposes.

password [parameter3].explanation: The command `password [parameter3]` sets or changes the password for a user or service in Junos, where `[parameter3]` specifies the new password.

ip-pool [parameter2].explanation: The command `ip-pool [parameter2]` in Junos configures a pool of IP addresses for dynamic assignment, where `[parameter2]` specifies the pool name or identifier.

parameters.name: ip-pool
parameters.explanation: The name of the IP address pool, for example, pool1.

set access address-assignment pool [para.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

family inet range [parameter2].explanation: Configures an IPv4 address range (`parameter2`) within an address-assignment pool (`parameter1`) for dynamic host configuration.

low [parameter3].explanation: Configures the minimum address range of the address pool.

high [parameter4].explanation: The command `high [parameter4]` in Junos sets the high threshold value for a specific parameter (parameter4) in a monitoring or traffic control context.

parameters.name: high
parameters.explanation: The high address of the address range.

family inet host-routing.explanation: The command `family inet host-routing` enables host-based routing for IPv4 addresses within a routing instance or interface configuration.

set services pppoe client dial-pool-numb.explanation: Configure the dialer pool number for the PPPoE client.

parameters.name: dial-pool-number
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: **Dialer pool number, for example, 1.**
